scen.briefing_en:
Learn basic and advanced training techniques - highly recommended for all upcoming commander trainees.

Train in any of or all of the following:
 Hand-to-hand combat
 Laser and gas weapons
 First Aid
 Research techniques.
scen.briefing_es:
Aprende técnicas básicas y avanzadas de entrenamiento, muy recomendables para todo aspirante a comandante.

Entrena en cualquiera de estas áreas:
 Combate cuerpo a cuerpo
 Armas láser y de gas
 Primeros auxilios
 Técnicas de investigación.

scen.briefing_en:
Prologue - Alien Arrival
Following the meteorite hit, we seem to have not heard from two marines on base duty. Several organic objects have also been discovered in the base - presumably pods of some kind.
You are to take a closer look at these pods to find out what they are.
scen.briefing_es:
Prólogo - Llegada alienígena
Tras el impacto del meteorito, perdimos contacto con dos soldados de guardia en la base. También aparecieron varios objetos orgánicos por la instalación, seguramente algún tipo de vainas.
Debes inspeccionar esas vainas de cerca para averiguar qué son.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 01 - First Encounter
It has been several days since the meteorite struck Redavi. It hit not far from Botanicus, the base that marks humankind's first landing on this planet.
23 hours ago the badly mutilated corpses of two troopers were discovered outside the base. 12 hours ago we lost contact with our kelp-processing installation Oceanus, and the promethium mine Polaris. A new life form must have emerged from the meteorite and made its way into Botanicus.  Power and communications have gone down, and the base is in chaos.
Under great pressure the remaining colonists have managed to secure a corner of the base, and we must now figure out how to fight back against this menace.
Use the ESPO to don an Environment Suit, then make your way through Redavi's toxic atmosphere to obtain a core sample from the original alien pod. We must ensure that Vivienne Pincus, our leading Biologist, can get to the Chemlab in Quarantine in the southwest of the base. She is confident that she can develop a weapon against the aliens.
Once this base is cleared of the aliens, we can attempt to track down any other enemy incursions.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 01 - Primer contacto
Han pasado varios días desde que el meteorito cayó sobre Redavi, muy cerca de Botanicus, la base que marcó el primer aterrizaje humano en este planeta.
Hace 23 horas hallaron fuera de la base los cadáveres mutilados de dos soldados. Hace 12 horas perdimos contacto con nuestra planta procesadora de algas Oceanus y la mina de prometio Polaris. Una nueva forma de vida emergió del meteorito y se infiltró en Botanicus. La energía y las comunicaciones cayeron; reina el caos.
Bajo enorme presión, los colonos sobrevivientes lograron asegurar un sector de la base. Ahora debemos descubrir cómo enfrentar esta amenaza.
Usa el ESPO para ponerte un traje ambiental, sal a la atmósfera tóxica de Redavi y toma una muestra del núcleo de la vaina original. Debemos asegurar que Vivienne Pincus, nuestra bióloga principal, llegue al laboratorio químico en Cuarentena al suroeste. Confía en desarrollar un arma contra los aliens.
Una vez despejada la base, rastrearemos cualquier otra incursión enemiga.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 02 - Alien Invasion 
Although successful in developing a defense against the aliens at Botanicus, these new ones seem to have adapted to that attack already. They display considerable intelligence, and this combined with a predatory nature makes them almost unstoppable.
We have lost contact with Polaris' custodians, and we must assume that they have fallen to the alien onslaught. With every encounter it becomes clear that the aliens are more powerful and adaptable than any creature we've seen previously.
An insertion team has been gathered to ascertain the extent of the invasion. If your weapons prove inadequate, the Physicist can improve them in the Techlab. Once you have eliminated the initial alien forces, use the Computer Terminal to locate the other colonists, then clear the way to their location.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 02 - Invasión alienígena
Aunque logramos desarrollar una defensa contra los aliens en Botanicus, esta nueva oleada ya parece haberse adaptado a ese ataque. Muestran una notable inteligencia que, sumada a su instinto depredador, los vuelve casi imparables.
Perdimos todo contacto con los encargados de Polaris y debemos asumir que sucumbieron ante la embestida. Cada encuentro demuestra que estas criaturas son más fuertes y adaptables que cualquier especie conocida.
Se reunió un equipo de incursión para evaluar el alcance de la invasión. Si nuestras armas resultan insuficientes, la Física puede mejorarlas en el laboratorio técnico. Tras eliminar las fuerzas iniciales, usa la terminal de cómputo para localizar a los demás colonos y despeja la ruta hacia ellos.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 03 - Search and Rescue 
We have abandoned Polaris for the time being, only to find Oceanus locked in battle when we arrived.  Charging into the melee, the Commander was knocked unconscious, and before reinforcements could be called, he was dragged away by the aliens.
The Commander's leadership is indispensable, especially in the current crisis, and he is the only one who can summon the drop-ship that will ferry us to the high ground of Tranquillity where research into the aliens continues.  He must be found and healed.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 03 - Búsqueda y rescate
Abandonamos Polaris por el momento, solo para encontrar a Oceanus envuelta en combate al llegar. Al lanzarse al frente, el Comandante quedó inconsciente y, antes de poder pedir refuerzos, fue arrastrado por los aliens.
Su liderazgo es indispensable en esta crisis, pues es el único autorizado para llamar la nave de descenso que nos llevará a las alturas de Tranquillity, donde continúa la investigación alienígena. Hay que encontrarlo y curarlo.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 04 - Never Say Die
After travelling for 3 days at maximum speed, an anti-insurgency team has arrived at the colony. All the base outer doors have been locked down and there are no signs of life anywhere. Your mission is to enter the base via the south entrance and proceed to do a full sweep, recovering any colonists you find. Orbital bombardment is scheduled to sanitise the entire zone, so be sure you're back at the Landing Field for dust-off in time. Seconds count people - no stopping for sight seeing.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 04 - Nunca te rindas
Tras viajar 3 días a máxima velocidad, un equipo contrainsurgencia llegó a la colonia. Todas las compuertas exteriores están selladas y no hay señales de vida. Tu misión es entrar por el acceso sur y barrer toda la base rescatando a los colonos que encuentres. Hay un bombardeo orbital programado para purgar la zona, así que vuelve a tiempo al Campo de aterrizaje para la extracción. Cada segundo cuenta: nada de distracciones.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 05 - Swarm 
Still reluctant to call for help from out-system, the Commander is recovering quickly. Despite his ordeal, he has managed to report information vital to our research.
Having cleared out the aliens at Oceanus, we have moved on to the lunar base, Tranquillity. And yet even its seclusion does not seem enough to keep it free of the alien taint.
Biologist Vivienne Pincus is conducting important research into the alien's biology here, and it must be allowed to continue. Once this research is complete, its application can be reviewed back on Redavi. The aliens must be purged, and any civilians have to be protected.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 05 - Enjambre
Aún reacio a pedir ayuda fuera del sistema, el Comandante se recupera rápido. Pese a lo vivido, logró aportar datos vitales para la investigación.
Tras despejar Oceanus, avanzamos hacia la base lunar Tranquillity. Sin embargo, ni siquiera su aislamiento la salvó del contagio alienígena.
La bióloga Vivienne Pincus investiga aquí la biología de los aliens y debe continuar su labor. Una vez terminada, aplicaremos los hallazgos en Redavi. Purguen a los aliens y protejan a todos los civiles.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 06 - War On Peace 
The colonists have temporarily evacuated to the Space Station, Peace. This upper orbit base should be far enough away from the infestation.
It is hoped that this will give us breathing space to study the information gathered at Tranquility, and use it somehow to bolster our weakening defences.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 06 - Guerra en Peace
Los colonos evacuaron temporalmente hacia la estación espacial Peace. Esta base en órbita alta debería estar lo bastante lejos de la infestación.
Esperamos que esto nos dé respiro para analizar los datos reunidos en Tranquillity y reforzar así nuestras mermadas defensas.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 07 - Escape 
We have lost communications with Polaris. This base supplies the colony and indeed Earth with Promethium, and as such it is vital to the colony's immediate and economic survival. All radio traffic is out, and it appears their reactor has been shut down. The automated transport pods that carry Promethium to Oceanus have prematurely triggered, and this may indicate that the aliens have already spread back to that base.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 07 - Escape
Perdimos las comunicaciones con Polaris. Esta base abastece de prometio a la colonia y a la Tierra, por lo que es vital para nuestra supervivencia económica e inmediata. No hay tráfico de radio y parece que su reactor fue apagado. Las cápsulas automatizadas de carga hacia Oceanus se activaron antes de tiempo, señal de que los aliens ya regresaron a esa base.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 08 - Treachery 
Having evacuated the personnel from Polaris, leaving its automated systems in charge, we have arrived at Botanicus, only to find that the infestation continues. As soon as one base is cleared of aliens, another shows signs of their taint. 
To complicate things further, the biologist Vivienne Pincus has locked us out of part of the base and will not answer our hails. She's already rendered some rooms deadly to human life as a crude shield against us.
She must be taken into custody. Once subdued, she will be transported to Oceanus for interrogation. From there, we will move our forces to Peace and see what data we can collect from high orbit.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 08 - Traición
Tras evacuar Polaris dejando sus sistemas en piloto automático, llegamos a Botanicus solo para ver que la infestación continúa. Apenas limpiamos una base, otra cae bajo el contagio.
Para colmo, la bióloga Vivienne Pincus nos bloqueó el paso a una sección de la base y no responde nuestros llamados. Incluso volvió mortales varias salas como escudo improvisado.
Debe ser detenida. Tras someterla, será trasladada a Oceanus para interrogarla. Luego moveremos tropas a Peace para recabar datos desde órbita alta.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 09 - Predators 
Biologist Vivienne Pincus has been temporarily suspended from duty after her outburst of irrationality. But outbursts like hers only help illustrate that the aliens definitely have us on the run.
Recent data indicates that there is something prowling the corridors of Oceanus. With the ability to stay invisible, it attacks then disappears so quickly that no victim can be found after their initial report. It's wearing us down, and we must develop a sensor device to give us the edge against this new hidden enemy before we attempt to gain access to the orbiting space station, Peace.
The Commander is hesitant to request help from out-system. If this colony falls, then Earth might never allow another one. He is determined to prevail.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 09 - Depredadores
Vivienne Pincus fue suspendida temporalmente tras su arranque irracional, prueba de hasta qué punto los aliens nos están acorralando.
Datos recientes señalan algo acechando los pasillos de Oceanus. Capaz de volverse invisible, ataca y desaparece tan rápido que no deja rastro tras el aviso inicial. Debemos fabricar un sensor para contrarrestar a este enemigo oculto antes de volver a la estación Peace.
El Comandante duda en pedir auxilio fuera del sistema: si esta colonia cae, la Tierra quizá no autorice otra. Está decidido a resistir.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 10 - Martial Law 
The Hunter aliens appear to be a product of their unstable genetic make-up, and we can expect more variations as the aliens interact with their new environment.
Meanwhile, on a reconnaissance mission to the Space Base, tensions have developed amongst the civilian colonists. The Biologist wants to preserve aliens for experiments, at the risk of losing lives in the process, while the Medical officer wants to evacuate everyone. The Technician is scared of damage to the computers in the base, the Cook is working on a new roast alien dish and doesn't want to be disturbed and the Barman is just refusing to cooperate.  The Commander has declared martial law.
Escort the uncooperative colonists safely to the docking bay to await evacuation to Polaris.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 10 - Ley marcial
Los aliens Cazadores son fruto de su inestable genética y veremos más mutaciones según se adapten al entorno.
Mientras tanto, en un reconocimiento en la Base Espacial, estalló la discordia entre los civiles: la Bióloga insiste en conservar aliens vivos, la Oficial médico exige evacuar a todos, el Técnico teme por las computadoras, el Cocinero prepara un platillo alíen asado y el Cantinero simplemente se niega a cooperar. El Comandante declaró la ley marcial.
Escolta a los colonos rebeldes hasta la bahía de acoplamiento rumbo a Polaris.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 11 - Berserker 
With the brief rebellion at Peace quelled for the time being, we are able to focus on more pressing problems.
At Polaris, the aliens have almost been eradicated from the base, but the Queen still survives. Raging around the base in motherly fury, she's become too dangerous to tackle head on. If we don't move quickly, we'll find our previous efforts have been in vain, as the Queen is nesting, spreading her tendrillon through the base at a rate no-one previously thought possible.  The only option is to develop a way to sterilise the queen before she lays too many eggs, then worry about destroying her afterwards.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 11 - Furia
Sofocada la rebelión en Peace, debemos atender amenazas urgentes.
En Polaris casi erradicamos la plaga, pero la Reina sobrevive. Desatada en furia maternal por la base, es demasiado letal para enfrentarla de frente. Si tardamos, todo habrá sido en vano: está anidando y esparciendo su tendrilón a velocidad pasmosa. La única salida es esterilizar a la Reina antes de que ponga más huevos y luego destruirla.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 12 - Nomads 
With the hive at Polaris under control for the moment, we have moved to the aquatic region to rest and heal. But this is not to be the case.
The aliens have made their way back to the aquatic base Oceanus. We must locate the source of the infestation and neutralize it. Since the aliens seem to have adjusted to our standard weaponry, we are forced to constantly develop new forms of attack. There is a Digital Bookcase containing valuable data in the Corridor in the northwest part of the base. It must be accessed, and the information used in conjunction with the Chemlab in the Manufacturing Room to modify whatever weapons are at hand.
Once this new threat is neutralised, we can respond to reports that Peace is under attack from a new form of enemy.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 12 - Nómadas
Contenida la colmena de Polaris por ahora, volvimos a la región acuática para descansar y sanar. No tuvimos suerte.
Los aliens regresaron a la base submarina Oceanus. Debemos hallar el foco de la infestación y neutralizarlo. Como ya se adaptaron a nuestras armas estándar, toca innovar. Hay un librero digital con datos valiosos en el pasillo noroeste; úsenlo junto con el laboratorio químico de Manufactura para modificar las armas disponibles.
Después responderemos al aviso de que Peace sufre el ataque de un nuevo enemigo.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 13 - Virus 
Still reluctant to call for help from out-system, and despite his ordeal, the Commander has still managed to deliver some vital information.
The aliens Grabbers apparently serve several purposes. It seems the aliens are able to absorb knowledge directly from colonists who are trapped within the Grabber's embrace, but there is new hope. Apparently, research at Polaris, interrupted by the invasion, may be useful in the current conflict.
But before this new data can be transmitted to Redavi, it has become apparent that something is wrong with Peace. The Space Station's main computer has gone haywire, randomly shutting down life support and other functions across the entire base. To make matters worse, the robot manufacturing plant is creating aggressive and dangerous robots. This new problem has to be related to the aliens, and may be viral in nature. Shut down the plant and find out what is ailing Peace.
If it is not possible to reclaim the Space Station, temporary evacuation may have to be implemented.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 13 - Virus
Aún sin pedir apoyo externo, el Comandante obtuvo información crucial pese a su calvario.
Los Capturadores absorben conocimiento de los colonos atrapados en sus tentáculos, pero hay esperanza: investigaciones de Polaris interrumpidas por la invasión podrían ayudarnos.
Antes de transmitir esos datos a Redavi, algo falló gravemente en Peace. La computadora central se volvió loca, apagando soporte vital y sistemas al azar, y la fábrica de robots produce máquinas asesinas. Esto tiene origen viral alienígena: apaguen la planta y reparen el sistema, o habrá que evacuar la estación.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 14 - Crashlander 
During the previous conflict, the mechanic inadvertently activated an escape pod and has crash-landed outside Botanicus. The pod was damaged in re-entry, so if the mechanic is to have any hope of summoning reinforcements, he must fix the distress beacon and await their arrival.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 14 - Náufrago
Durante el combate anterior, el mecánico activó por accidente una cápsula de escape y se estrelló fuera de Botanicus. La cápsula sufrió daños en la reentrada; si quiere pedir rescate, deberá reparar la baliza de emergencia y aguantar hasta que lleguen refuerzos.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 15 - Stealth 
The aliens have spread quickly and thoroughly.  Their taint can be felt in every base, from one-on-one battles to bizarre viral infections.  These aliens are ever changing, and they adapt quickly to anything we throw at them. 
At Polaris, the alien invasion began while new defensive devices were being researched. This technology is essential to our battle, and the base must be cleared of aliens.  Find the lab, find the research, and sterilise the base.
The research will then be brought to Peace where it can be studied thoroughly.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 15 - Sigilo
La plaga se ha propagado con rapidez implacable, desde combates cuerpo a cuerpo hasta extrañas infecciones virales. Estos aliens mutan y se adaptan a todo lo que les lanzamos.
En Polaris, la invasión golpeó mientras se investigaban nuevos dispositivos defensivos. Esa tecnología es vital: encuentren el laboratorio, recuperen la investigación y esterilicen la base.
Luego llevaremos esos datos a Peace para estudiarlos a fondo.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 16 - Chrysalis 
The fight went well on Polaris, but it's impossible to wipe out the bugs from any one place entirely.
A queen has chosen to nest here, and she is repopulating the space station with her brood. We have received new reports that Oceanus is lost to a fresh batch of aliens, a major blow as its kelp-harvesting program provides the rest of the colony with food.
But that problem will pale in comparison if we can't wrestle the Space Station out of the aliens' grasp. We could lose all communications with Earth and the Training Colonies, and any hope of receiving reinforcements.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 16 - Crisálida
La lucha en Polaris salió bien, pero es imposible exterminar la plaga de un sitio por completo.
Una Reina anidó aquí y repuebla la estación espacial con su prole. Además, llegan reportes de que Oceanus cayó ante una nueva oleada, golpe duro pues sus cosechas de algas alimentan a toda la colonia.
Pero nada importará si no recuperamos la estación Peace: podríamos perder todo enlace con la Tierra, las colonias de entrenamiento y cualquier esperanza de refuerzos.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 17 - Lockdown 
Tragic news. A strange illness has rendered Commander Batista feverish and violent.  Whatever the cause, the Medical officer is certain of one thing - without a cure, his condition is fatal. In a matter of half an hour he will die. 
For the time being, he has been quarantined in the toilet block. This is for his own protection as much as everyone else's. A formidable number of aliens surround the Med Bay, including the highly dangerous Hunters variety. More ominous still, the enemy seems to be waiting . . . for what, it's not clear.
We must find out quickly, as reports of a new breed of alien have come in from Botanicus, a breed that threatens our hold on this planet.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 17 - Confinamiento
Malas noticias: una extraña enfermedad tiene al Comandante Batista febril y violento. Sin cura, morirá en apenas media hora.
Por seguridad, lo pusieron en cuarentena en el bloque de baños. Una horda enorme rodea la Bahía médica, incluidos peligrosos Cazadores, y parecen estar esperando algo...
Debemos actuar rápido: desde Botanicus reportan una nueva casta alienígena que amenaza nuestro control del planeta.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 18 - Sentience 
A decisive victory seems impossible. As soon as one swarm of aliens is defeated, another replaces it. The fight at Oceanus has been put on hold so that new intelligence could be reviewed. The news is not good.
They can think! The aliens are showing signs of sentience. It may be that they can use tools, open doors, use any piece of technology we can. That makes them far more dangerous than originally thought. Track each alien down and terminate it with extreme prejudice.
If this base can be made secure, a small contingent can be sent back to Polaris to finish off the aliens that plague it. Meanwhile, the rest of the colonists will move back to Peace, where the Commander has finally decided to send out a distress call.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 18 - Sapiencia
Una victoria decisiva parece lejana; apenas cae un enjambre, surge otro. Detuvimos la ofensiva en Oceanus al analizar nuevos datos de inteligencia, y las noticias son alarmantes.
¡Pueden pensar! Muestran señales de raciocinio: usan herramientas, abren puertas y operan nuestra tecnología. Rastreen y eliminen a cada criatura sin piedad.
Si aseguramos esta base, un escuadrón volverá a Polaris para rematar los focos restantes, mientras el resto regresa a Peace, donde el Comandante decidió por fin enviar una señal de auxilio.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 19 - Guardian System 
The thinkers seem a permanent development in the alien's biology, but their small numbers are nothing compared to the massing of forces that has occurred at Polaris.
The battle at this base has run long and hard. Ammunition supplies have run low, and the colonists have been forced to fall back on the base's aging and disused security system. It is imperative that the automatic defence turrets are brought on line as quickly as possible. They'll only work once, so they better work first time.
When Polaris has been wiped clean of the pervading alien tendrillon, we can join the others on Peace.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 19 - Sistema Guardián
Los Pensadores ya son parte estable de la biología alíen, aunque su número es nada comparado con el ejército reunido en Polaris.
La batalla se alargó, queda poca munición y los colonos tuvieron que recurrir al viejo sistema de seguridad. Hay que activar las torretas automáticas cuanto antes: solo dispararán una vez, así que más vale aprovecharlas bien.
Cuando Polaris esté libre del tendrilón alienígena, nos reuniremos en Peace.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 20 - Lock 'n' Load 
There has been a very fierce battle. Many crew members have been lost and ammunition is low. The lower portion of the base is the only section that remains under our control. We've exterminated as much of the alien presence as possible, but several eggs have survived and are likely to hatch quickly.
The relative isolation of Peace offers a chance to capture several alien specimens for observation before they grow to full strength, possibly including an alien Queen.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 20 - Carguen armas
El combate ha sido feroz. Perdimos muchos compañeros y escasea la munición; solo controlamos la zona inferior de la base. Exterminamos casi toda presencia alien, pero sobrevivieron varios huevos listos para eclosionar.
El aislamiento de Peace ofrece la oportunidad de capturar especímenes antes de que maduren, posiblemente incluso una Reina.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 21 - Tendrillon Infestation 
The distress signal has been sent, but there will still be a delay before we can expect any help from Earth.
Meanwhile, there has been a massive conflict between aliens and colonists at Oceanus, and the base has been devastated. The medical sector of this base is overflowing with casualties, and it must remain free from alien tendrillon so the Medical Officer can complete her tasks.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 21 - Infestación Tendrilón
La señal de auxilio ya fue enviada, pero la ayuda de la Tierra tardará en llegar.
Mientras tanto, un combate masivo entre aliens y colonos devastó Oceanus. El sector médico está desbordado de heridos y debe mantenerse libre de tendrilón alienígena para que la Oficial médico pueda trabajar.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 22 - Impact 
Our colonists have barely had time to grieve the loss of their fallen comrades, or welcome the return of those healed, as tragedy follows tragedy.
The lunar base has been bombarded by a small meteorite storm.  Communications, power, everything is down. We have no way of knowing the status of the base or it's inhabitants.  If the magnetic accelerator which handles inter-system cargo cannot be shut down, it could potentially misfire at the Space Station, or even Redavi itself.
In theory, if the Polar Regions were stuck with such a powerful magnetic force, the unstable Promethium could ignite, spelling doom for the entire planet.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 22 - Impacto
Apenas tuvimos tiempo para llorar a nuestros caídos o celebrar a los curados cuando cae otra tragedia.
La base lunar fue golpeada por una lluvia de meteoritos; comunicaciones y energía cayeron y desconocemos la situación adentro. Si no apagamos el acelerador magnético de carga interplanetaria, podría disparar hacia la estación Peace o el propio Redavi.
En teoría, si ese haz impacta los polos, el prometio inestable ardería y condenaría al planeta entero.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 23 - Interceptor 
Before destroying itself and the base in a power overload, Tranquillity's magnetic accelerator has raked a path of destruction across Redavi, igniting the raw promethium deep below the Polar ice. A massive chain reaction has ensued, and there is a strong possibility the planet will become an uninhabitable fireball in less than 48 hours. Preparations for the evacuation of the planet have begun already at Botanicus and Oceanus, hindered only by the increasing alien population.
As if things weren't bad enough, enemies from out of system have reared their ugly head. The meteorite storm that crippled Tranquillity may have been an artificial diversion, as our sensors have picked up a craft in Redavi's vicinity. Since Polaris is the main source of Promethium in this system, we can only assume that our old foes, the UK/CA, are after a sample. With Tranquillity gone, we have no way of stopping the ship from escaping. We must stop the spy from leaving the system with any information or samples.
For once, though, the aliens may work for us. The UKCA espionage agent will have to move as carefully as we do to avoid the predatory creatures.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 23 - Interceptor
Antes de sobrecargarse y destruir Tranquillity, el acelerador magnético barrió Redavi encendiendo el prometio bajo el hielo polar. Una reacción en cadena amenaza con volver el planeta una bola de fuego en menos de 48 horas. Ya comenzó la evacuación en Botanicus y Oceanus, frenada por los aliens.
Por si fuera poco, nuestros sensores detectaron una nave espía enemiga de la UK/CA cerca de Redavi, buscando muestras de prometio. Quizá la lluvia de meteoritos fue un sabotaje. Sin Tranquillity, no podemos detener la nave, pero sí impedir que el espía escape con muestras o datos.
Por una vez, los aliens podrían estorbarle también a él.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 24 - Countdown 
The spy has been dealt with accordingly, and his pick-up ship has departed the system, but his involvement can only mean the distress call was jammed from the start.  This revelation has dashed all hopes of receiving additional troops from out-system, the little good that they would do us.
Redavi burns. Yet although the planet may be doomed, and though we must quickly move on to Oceanus to continue the evacuation, the temptation to inflict real damage upon the aliens has kept the Commander here.  Botanicus and the surrounding lands are completely infested.  All personnel must be evacuated, and all sensitive information erased from the base's logs.  Finally, although possibly overkill, the reactor must be set to overload.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 24 - Cuenta regresiva
El espía fue neutralizado y su nave huyó, pero su presencia confirma que nuestra señal de auxilio fue bloqueada desde el inicio: no habrá refuerzos externos.
Redavi arde. Aunque el planeta está condenado y debamos evacuar hacia Oceanus, el Comandante quiere asestar un último golpe mortal a la plaga. Botanicus está perdida; evacuen al personal, borren los registros confidenciales y sobrecarguen el reactor antes de irse.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 25 - Xenocide 
Although we have won some battles, we are losing the war. With every attack, the aliens pick off more of our people, take more of our territory. Their insidious advance seems unstoppable.
Oceanus will be our final battleground before we retreat to space to watch Redavi's death throes. It cannot be evacuated safely until the alien menace has been dealt with thoroughly.
Morale has reached new depths, and we need a victory. Drastic measures must be taken.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 25 - Xenocidio
Aunque ganamos batallas, estamos perdiendo la guerra. Con cada asalto nos arrebatan más vidas y territorio.
Oceanus será nuestro último campo de batalla antes de retirarnos al espacio para ver morir a Redavi. No podemos evacuar con seguridad sin aplastar antes a la amenaza alienígena.
La moral está por los suelos y necesitamos una victoria. Toca tomar medidas drásticas.

scen.briefing_en:
Episode 26 - Terminus 
As Redavi burns, our sensors are able to record the last moments of Oceanus before the waters around it were vaporised along with the base itself.  We have retreated to Peace to watch the demise of the planet, only to find this last point of human contact in the system has been compromised.
Before we can finally abandon this system, you have one last chance to avenge yourself, to wipe out the aliens, and to seek justice.  Clear the space station of aliens.  Leave it standing as a testimony of your victory, and a marker for those who perished in the struggle.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio 26 - Terminus
Mientras Redavi arde, nuestros sensores captaron los últimos instantes de Oceanus antes de que el océano se vaporizara junto con la base. Nos replegamos a Peace para presenciar el fin del planeta, solo para hallar comprometido nuestro último refugio.
Antes de abandonar este sistema para siempre, queda una última oportunidad de venganza, exterminio y justicia. Limpia la estación espacial de aliens y déjala en pie como monumento a tu victoria y a quienes cayeron en la lucha.

scen.briefing_en:
Multiplayer 01 - Cavalry 
The space station has been taken over by the aliens. Outnumbered and overwhelmed, we believe the colonists aboard Peace have been captured to be used as hosts for more aliens. You and your colleague must lead a team of troops and specialists on a rescue mission to save them. The station is no longer of any use to us and must be destroyed before the aliens escape. Good luck.

This scenario is for Low End computer systems.
scen.briefing_es:
Multijugador 01 - Caballería
Los aliens tomaron la estación espacial Peace. Superados en número, creemos que los colonos capturados serán usados como huéspedes para criar más criaturas. Tú y tu aliado lideran un equipo de asalto y especialistas para rescatarlos. La estación ya no nos sirve y debe ser destruida antes de que escapen. Suerte.

Escenario recomendado para equipos de gama baja.

scen.briefing_en:
Multiplayer 02 - Property Damage 
Eco Disaster! When all of the adult aliens were killed, the cocoons began to grow unchecked. Now the base is swarming with viscious babies and their constant attacks have broken the colonist's morale and every piece of technology in the base. You must coordinate your troops, rally the colonists, fix all of the broken items and destroy every last remnant of the alien plague.

This scenario is for Low End computer systems.
scen.briefing_es:
Multijugador 02 - Daños materiales
¡Desastre ecológico! Al matar a todos los aliens adultos, los capullos crecieron sin control. Ahora la base rebosa de larvas feroces cuyos ataques quebraron la moral y destruyeron toda la tecnología. Coordina tropas, reúne a los colonos, repara los equipos averiados y extermina hasta el último vestigio de la plaga.

Escenario recomendado para equipos de gama baja.

scen.briefing_en:
Multiplayer 03 - Outbreak 
The ice miner has returned after a long journey, only to find the base has been taken by the aliens. A small group of survivors are trapped and need your help. Unfortunately, the power generators are unstable causing explosive chaos around the base. The explosions have caused the aliens to panic and chase down any colonist they see. A huge explosion is expected, and will totally destroy the base. When this happens much of the ice miner will also be affected. It seems the only safe place is the pumping station located in the south west of the base as it's protected by the miner itself.

This scenario is for Mid Range computer systems.
scen.briefing_es:
Multijugador 03 - Brote alienígena
El carguero de hielo regresó tras un largo viaje y halló la base invadida. Un puñado de sobrevivientes atrapados pide ayuda, pero los generadores son inestables y provocan explosiones por toda la base, desatando el pánico entre los aliens. Se espera una detonación masiva que destruirá casi todo; el único refugio seguro parece ser la Estación de bombeo al suroeste, protegida por el propio carguero.

Escenario recomendado para equipos de gama media.

scen.briefing_en:
Multiplayer 04 - Polaris Lost 
After fierce fighting the aliens have taken over a large portion of the base. They have captured the biologist and are sucking crucial information from her brain, information which has enabled them to clone their queen and speed up gestation periods. Meanwhile the Commander and a group of troopers, badly injured during the conflicts, have barricaded themselves into a room somewhere on the base. The  physicist has collapsed outdoors and a fire is burning out of control across the mid section of the base. Swift action must be taken in order to save Polaris from imminent alien infestation.

This scenario is for Mid Range computer systems.
scen.briefing_es:
Multijugador 04 - Polaris perdida
Tras feroz combate, los aliens controlan gran parte de la base. Capturaron a la bióloga y le extraen información vital para clonar a su Reina y acelerar la gestación. El Comandante y varios soldados heridos se atrincheraron en una sala, la Física yace inconsciente en el exterior y un incendio arrasa el sector central. Hay que actuar ya para salvar Polaris.

Escenario recomendado para equipos de gama media.

scen.briefing_en:
Multiplayer 05 - Body Snatchers 
The aliens now have highly advanced knowledge and technology, due to the relentless sucking of information from captured colonists. So much so that the thinkers have induced a zombie-like state in a handful of colonists, and have implanted alien DNA into the colonists cells. The master plan of the aliens seems to be to create a hybrid alien-human species who will be sent out as moles to infiltrate all other human colonies in the galaxy. Prevention of this catastrophic event is entirely the responsibility of the remaining crew on Peace.

This scenario is for Mid Range computer systems.
scen.briefing_es:
Multijugador 05 - Ladrones de cuerpos
Gracias al conocimiento robado a colonos capturados, los Pensadores indujeron un estado zombi en varios tripulantes e implantaron ADN alienígena en sus células. Su plan es crear híbridos infiltrados para invadir todas las colonias humanas de la galaxia. Solo la tripulación restante en Peace puede evitar la catástrofe.

Escenario recomendado para equipos de gama media.

scen.briefing_en:
Multiplayer 06 - Revenge 
Three alien Queens have found their way into the base and must be destroyed. They are breeding fast and if not stopped, the base will be lost for certain. Your troops have been called in to fix the situation. Divided into three teams, you must work together to kill the enemy and save the base.

This scenario is for High End computer systems.
scen.briefing_es:
Multijugador 06 - Venganza
Tres Reinas alienígenas se infiltraron en la base y deben ser destruidas. Se reproducen rápido y, si no las detenemos, perderemos la instalación. Tu fuerza fue desplegada para resolverlo: divididos en tres equipos, cooperen para eliminar al enemigo y salvar la base.

Escenario recomendado para equipos de gama alta.

scen.briefing_en:
Multiplayer 07 - Free For All 
The aliens have had a population explosion. All the colonists must use their abilities to find the hive and kill the enemy off. In the panic, the Physicist has been accidentally locked in the bathroom. Weapons have been abandoned in the lower level of the base from a previous battle, but the lifts are locked. It has been suggested that the computer terminal might contain useful information. Perhaps some bait could be developed to lead the Aliens to be killed.

This scenario is for Low End computer systems.
scen.briefing_es:
Multijugador 07 - Todos contra todos
La población alíen se disparó. Todos los colonos deben usar sus habilidades para hallar la colmena y acabar con ellos. En el pánico, encerraron por accidente a la Física en el baño. Quedaron armas en el nivel inferior, pero los elevadores están bloqueados. Quizá la terminal de cómputo tenga datos útiles, o puedan preparar algún cebo para atraer a los aliens.

Escenario recomendado para equipos de gama baja.

scen.briefing_en:
Multiplayer 08 - Rebellion
Our worst fears have come true. A psychotic revolutionary named Austin Teksas, has taken over the Botanicus outpost. He and his terrorists are holding five hostages for ransom in return for his captive son, who was arrested for attempting to assassinate a prominent corporate figure. Teksas is threatening to destroy the base with a nuclear device, which he will detonate if attacked. Having avoided capture and unknown to the terrorists, Commander Batista and Medical officer Medici are the only one's who can save the hostages and call for reinforcements. This madman must be stopped.

This scenario is for Mid Range computer systems.
scen.briefing_es:
Multijugador 08 - Rebelión
Nuestros peores temores se cumplieron: un revolucionario demente llamado Austin Teksas tomó la base Botanicus junto con sus terroristas y mantiene cinco rehenes a cambio de su hijo preso. Amenaza con detonar un artefacto nuclear si lo atacan. Ocultos del enemigo, el Comandante Batista y la Oficial médico Medici son los únicos capaces de rescatar a los rehenes y pedir refuerzos.

Escenario recomendado para equipos de gama media.

scen.briefing_en:
Multiplayer 09 - Queens Galore 
The lunar base is heavily infested, to a degree never before seen. The usually aggressive aliens have gone berserk, and Queens have become prolific. The battle ahead will be long and harsh, but if the aliens learn anything from their contact with humans, it's that we never quit. Ever.

This scenario is for High End computer systems.
scen.briefing_es:
Episodio Multijugador 09 - Reinas por doquier
La base lunar sufre una infestación sin precedentes. Los aliens normalmente agresivos entraron en frenesí y proliferan las Reinas. Será una batalla larga y brutal, pero si algo deben aprender estas criaturas de la humanidad es que jamás nos rendimos.

Escenario recomendado para equipos de gama alta.

scen.briefing_en:
Multiplayer 10 - System Failure 
The colonists have successfully captured the queen, as well as a large collection of adult and baby aliens. The biologist has been given orders to examine the species - particularly the queen. However, the aliens have built up a resistance to the tranquiliser that up until now has kept them in a semi-conscious state. They are rapidly awakening and will soon break free from their impromptu holding cells. Meanwhile, multiple systems across the base integral to the colonist's survival have malfunctioned and require immediate attention.

This scenario is for Low End computer systems.
scen.briefing_es:
Multijugador 10 - Falla del sistema
Los colonos capturaron a la Reina junto con varias crías y adultos. La bióloga debe estudiarlos, pero los aliens desarrollaron resistencia al tranquilizante y pronto escaparán de sus celdas improvisadas. Mientras tanto, múltiples sistemas vitales de la base han fallado y exigen reparación inmediata.

Escenario recomendado para equipos de gama baja.
